messages:
sara_cs: FYI customer AcmeCorp just opened a ticket — dashboard shows 4.2M tokens for Feb but invoice line is 5.1M. They say their plan tier also moved from Standard->Pro on the invoice. Can someone look?
ben_eng: ack, can you paste the invoice line and a screenshot of the dashboard?
sara_cs: pasted attachments in the ticket. Quick notes: account_id acct_9z72, invoice #INV-2023-02-ACME. Dashboard export CSV attached shows plan=standard, tokens=4217032. Invoice line: plan=pro, tokens_billed=5101200.
tom_support: pinging billing team — seems like a plan-classification flip during end-of-month job. Lia, any recent runs that could've remapped plan tiers?
lia_billing: looking now. We had a backfill job for legacy plan migrations on 1756429000 that touched many accounts. I don't see acct_9z72 in the affected list but will grep.
lia_billing: grep result: acct_9z72 appeared in a partial join on the consolidation query at 1756429401 — the join matched a legacy plan alias (legacy_pro) due to duplicated plan_id in plan_mappings table.
eve_finance: is that enough to change tier on the invoice? invoices are generated from the final billing snapshot at cutoff, not the dashboard export. If the backfill altered plan_mappings before snapshot finalize it could.
lia_billing: correct. It looks like the backfill updated plan_mapping for that account at 1756429401 which was just before our cutoff at 1756432000. That would make the invoice pick up the new tier.
ben_eng: can we reproduce locally? what query produced the dashboard export vs what feeds invoice generator?
sara_cs: from support ticket: dashboard export uses materialized view mv_usage_by_account (snapshot at 1756428000), invoice generator queries billing_snapshot.final_snapshot (cutoff 1756432000). So timing mismatch.
ben_eng: repro steps: 1) run the backfill (or simulate) to write plan_mappings change, 2) run materialize view refresh at t1, 3) run invoice snapshot at t2 where t1 < t2 and change falls between. We should be able to recreate with a test account.
tom_support: customer wants credit or corrected invoice. What's our immediate remediation plan?
eve_finance: options: a) issue credit for the delta while we fix backfill ordering, b) regenerate invoice if within adjustment window. We need a clear repro and audit trail first.
lia_billing: attaching query snippet that caused the wrong map: ```UPDATE plan_mappings SET plan_id='pro' WHERE alias='legacy_pro' AND updated_at < '1756429500';``` looks like the WHERE clause inadvertently applied to more rows.
ben_eng: thanks. I'll run a dry-run to find all accounts affected and produce a list. If it's <50 accounts maybe we can do targeted adjustments.
metering-bot: audit-log: plan_mappings:update acct_9z72 changed plan_id from "standard" -> "pro" at 1756429401 by job:legacy-plan-backfill-2023-02
sara_cs: communicated to customer that we're investigating and asked if they'd accept a temporary credit while we confirm the full impact. They replied :thumbsup: and want ETA.
eve_finance: target: list of affected accounts + delta calculations in 4 hours, remediation plan within 24h. Lia and Ben please coordinate.
ben_eng: will do. I'll include exact SQL diffs and a small script to compute per-account token deltas between mv_usage_by_account(t1) and final_snapshot(t2).
lia_billing: created support ticket update and will pause further backfill jobs until a patch to the WHERE clause is deployed.
sara_cs: thanks team — keeping customer updated. Will post final notes here when we have the list. :white_check_mark:
